subject.title: [Bug]: MS Teams inbound mentions, quoted replies, and forwards are not normalized for agent text

question: Should maintainers accept a fixture-backed Teams plugin repair for these inbound mention, quotedReply, and Forward wire shapes now, or require a live tenant replay first?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the protected `maintainer` label and lack of live tenant replay make this a maintainer-owned intake decision rather than an automatic repair lane.

options.title: Proceed with maintainer-owned fix
options.body: Implement the normalizer with anonymized Teams activity fixtures now, while requesting live replay proof before merge if feasible.

options.title: Wait for live tenant replay
options.body: Hold implementation until a maintainer or reporter can provide redacted raw gateway payloads for mentions, quoted replies, and forwards.

recommendation.title: Proceed with maintainer-owned fix
recommendation.body: Implement the normalizer with anonymized Teams activity fixtures now, while requesting live replay proof before merge if feasible.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest broad Teams plugin routing candidate from area history and can decide whether the protected issue should enter a maintainer-owned repair lane.
